SELECT
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(DISTINCT r.review_score)::numeric, 2) AS average_review_score,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) AS review_count
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE r.review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY average_review_score DESC;
